title.label: Good app except for one thing

content.label:
Everything about this app is great, but having to pay for intentional app switching is crazy.

The fact that it’s there shows that the app can tell when you only want to leave something for a second, which means people who don’t pay will:
- naturally get used to skipping the reminder when it’s intentionally put in your face for no reason
- stop caring about the number of times they’ve opened an app because the number is at least doubled by this alone

All of the other premium features make sense, but this just feels like the devs don’t want the app to work for free long term. 

Other than that, it’s pretty nice.
